findings.title: Static shared java.sql.Connection — concurrent access causes transaction interleaving
findings.remediation: Replace with DataSource.getConnection() in try-with-resources per request.

findings.title: Hardcoded credential/secret in SonarReport.java
findings.remediation: Externalize secrets to environment variables or a secrets manager.

findings.title: pom.xml hardcodes keystorePass=changeit in Cargo deployment config (5 profiles)
findings.remediation: Use Maven property with env-var source: ${env.KEYSTORE_PASS}

findings.title: NoopHostnameVerifier disables certificate hostname validation — MITM risk
findings.remediation: Use DefaultHostnameVerifier or SSLConnectionSocketFactory default.

findings.title: SSLContext constrained to TLSv1 only — prohibited by RFC 8996
findings.remediation: Replace with new String[]{"TLSv1.2","TLSv1.3"}.

findings.title: NoopHostnameVerifier disables certificate hostname validation — MITM risk
findings.remediation: Use DefaultHostnameVerifier or SSLConnectionSocketFactory default.

findings.title: hideSQLErrors=false — full SQLException stack traces sent to HTTP clients
findings.remediation: Set hideSQLErrors=true; never expose internal SQL errors to end users.

findings.title: Weak crypto in infrastructure: ECB cipher mode — deterministic, leaks block patterns (Utils.java)
findings.remediation: Use AES-256-GCM or AES-256-CCM; use SHA-256+ for hashing.

findings.title: Binary keystore file committed to SCM (2233 bytes, SHA-256: 6c7366d55fb0ea56…)
findings.remediation: Add .keystore to .gitignore; use CI-injected secrets or Let's Encrypt.

findings.title: ExpressionEvaluator.java — all methods return null (dead code stub)
findings.remediation: Remove or implement ExpressionEvaluator; dead stubs inflate bytecode.

findings.title: JNDI pool maxTotal=12 but DatabaseHelper caches exactly 1 static Connection — 11 slots wasted
findings.remediation: Checkout connection per-request from the pool; set maxTotal=1 until fixed.

findings.title: @RestController in helpers/DataBaseServer.java — exposes /getall endpoint outside test boundary
findings.remediation: Move management endpoints behind an authenticated admin path; never expose benchmark DB via unauthenticated REST.

findings.title: Potential resource leak: PrintWriter not in try-with-resources (Utils.java:115)
findings.remediation: Wrap resource in try-with-resources to guarantee close() on all paths.
